title: tc-embed-widget
description:
The chat a visitor opens on a website: a corner launcher with an unread count, and a panel with a greeting,
starters, the conversation and a message field, styled by `theme`.

heading.description: The agent's name in the header (theme.title overrides it)

subtitle.description: The line under the name, e.g. how fast it replies

avatar.description: The agent's picture – a URL; initials of the name when there's none

greeting.description: The first message, from the agent (theme.greeting overrides it)

starters.description: Starter questions, shown until the visitor has written

messages.description: The conversation, oldest first – the page appends the visitor's messages and the replies

typing.description: The agent is writing a reply: dots at the end of the conversation

unread.description: Messages the visitor hasn't seen, as a count on the launcher while the panel is closed

floating.description: Pin the widget to the window's corner, as on a site; otherwise it sits in the page's flow

position.description: Which corner the launcher sits in (theme.position overrides it)

theme.description: How the site styles it: accent, radius, side, greeting, title and launcher words

privacy.description: The privacy line under the message field; empty hides it

privacyHref.description: Where the privacy line's link goes; none hides the link

labels.description: The widget's words, merged over defaultEmbedWidgetLabels

EmbedStarter.description: A starter question shown before the visitor has written

name.description: A person's name (from "human", or who joined for "handoff")

EmbedMessageFrom.description: Who a message is from: the visitor, the AI assistant, a person who took over, or a notice that one joined
